s: Din hepseq vetaut bebirkat happerot, ubo t"v seipim: berak al perot hailan "bore peri haadama" — yatza, hoil veiqqar hailan hu min haaretz. Abal im berak al perot haaretz "bore peri haetz" — lo yatza. Lepikak, im hu mesuppaq bipri im hu peri etz o peri haadama — yebarek "bore peri haadama", veyetze mimmah napshak. Veal hakkol im berak "shehakkol nihya bidbaro" — yatza, vaapillu al pat veyayin. Vekol zeh bediabad, abal lekattechilla tzarik lebarek al kol dabar birkato hammeyuchedet lo, ella im ken nolad lo sapeq achar shellamad kemo shennitbaer besiman [r"b] :

Hayu lepanayv peri haadama uperi haetz uberak techilla al peri haadama — tzarik lachazor ulebarek al peri haetz, ki lo niptar bebirkat "bore peri haadama" ella keshebberak alayv velo keshebberak al peri haadama. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimbarek bistam, abal im nitkavven liptor bebirkato gam peri haetz — yatza, vaapillu lo hayu peri haetz adayin lepanayv keshebberak veachar kak hebiuhu lepanayv:

Kol ellu habberakot tzarik shello yapsiq ben habberaka laakila, apillu mippene hakkabod vehayyira. Veim hipsiq vedibber dibbur sheeno letzorek haakila — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"z. Vaapillu bishtiqa asur lehapsiq yoter mikkede dibbur, shehu kede sheelat shalom talmid larab, shehen g' tebot ellu: "shalom aleka rabbi". Veim shaha yoter — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Ushehiyya shehi letzorek akila — enah chashuba hepseq kelal apillu lekattechilla. Lepikak, hambarek al happeri vechotek mimmennu veokel — lo yachtok ad achar habberaka, kede sheyyebarek al hashshalem lemitzva min hammubchar, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch. Veen lachosh lehepseq shehiyyat hachittuk ben habberaka laakila, hoil vehu tzorek akila. Umikkol maqom, haokel egoz vekayyotze bo — yishberennu veachar kak yebarek, ki shemma hitlia betoko o nirqab, venimtza berak lebattala:
Kol habberakot neemarot bekol lashon. Veim tzarik lehabin habberakot — nitbaer besiman qp"h:
Vetzarik sheyyashmia leoznayv. Veim lo hishmia — yatza, ubilbad sheyyotzi bispatayv, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"h:

Vetzarik lizzaher mitztzoa ume raglayim vegilluy erva velibbo roeh et haerva, kemo biqriat shema. Vehaishsha mutteret lesheb arumma ulebarek, mippene shebbishibatah paneha shel matta mekussim baqqarqa o bassapsal shehi yoshebet alayv, ubeyarkoteha keshettashveh ragleha veteesop otan zo lazo, mah sheen ken beish shehaggid vehabbetzim boletim venirim:
En lebarek begilluy harosh, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz"a:

Kol dabar shemmebarek alayv leoklo o lehariach bo o laasot bo mitzva — tzarik leechoz bimino keshehu mebarek. Veyesh mi sheomer, sheal derek haqqabbala en litchob happeri shemmebarek alayv besakkin veleechoz hassakkin bimino, ki hem b' hapakim benose echad, shehayyamin mimmenna "totzeot chayyim", vehassakkin hu kocho shel esav hamqatztzer chayyim, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"p:

Veim lo achazo kelal, im haya lepanayv keshebberak alayv — yatza. Veim berak veachar kak hebiu lepanayv, ap shebberak al daat ken — tzarik lachazor ulebarek. Abal mi shebberak al perot shellepanayv veachar kak hebiu lo yoter meoto hammin, o mimmin acher shenniptar babberaka harishona, kegon shebbirkotehem shavot, o sheharishon iqqar vehashsheni tapel — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, apillu hebiu lepanayv min haacher achar shekkala harishon, shekkebar akalo kullo. Vehu shekkeshebberak haya dato gam al hashsheni leoklo, apillu lo haya bedato beperush lepotro bibraka zo, abal im lo hayeta dato alayv bishat habberaka — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, im kebar akal harishon qodem shehebiu min haacher lepanayv. Abal im yesh adayin lepanayv mimmin harishon keshehebiu lepanayv min acher haddomeh leharishon, kegon sheshshenehem mine perot, o sheshshenehem mine mashqin — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv, shekkol zeman shehu oseq baakilat o shetiyyat harishon — eno oseh hessach haddaat min hassetam, ella im ken nimlak mammash, lepi shekken darko shel adam keshehu oseq baakila o bishtiyya, lehimmashek bah veligror meakila laakila umishshetiyya lishtiyya. Abal im shoteh shekar vehebiu lo dagim lematteq hashshetiyya, ap al pi shehakkol beraka achat, vegam haddagim hem tepelim lehashshekar, sheal yede kak shoteh yoter — enam niptarim bibraka achat, ella im ken hayeta dato alehem, o shehayu lepanayv bishat beraka, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ry"b. (Veim hebiu lepanayv meoto hammin mammash, ap im kebar akal harishon kullo — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella im ken hu nimlak mammash. Abal bistam eno oseh hessach haddaat mimmin zeh shehaya lepanayv bishat habberaka lihyot nimna milleoklo od kesheyyabiu lepanayv, lepi sheddarko shel adam lehimmashek baakila uleharbot bah meachar shehitchil bah). Veyesh omerim, shello ameru ken ella bisuda sheadam qobea atzmo bah, abal beperot vekayyotze bahem, ap im qobea atzmo bahem — en qebiato kelum, sheen qeba leperot, vekevan shello hayeta dato al mah shehebiu lepanayv achar habberaka, ap sheeno nimlak mammash — tzarik lachazor ulebarek bekol inyan, ap im hebiu lo meoto hammin mammash, velo akal adayin harishon. Usepeq berakot lehaqel. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla tob lizzaher lihyot dato al kol mah sheyyabiu lo. Veorechim haqqeruim leekol mine perot, kevan sheddatam al baal habbayit shezzimmenam — hare datam al kol mah shehebi lipnehem, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t. Vaapillu hebi lipnehem min acher achar shekkala harishon — en tzerikim lachazor ulebarek:

Vekol zeh kesheharishon vehashsheni hem shavim bachashibut, sheen lazeh qedima al zeh im hayu shenehem lepanayv, abal im hashsheni chashub meharishon mippene shehu min z', o shehu chabib, al derek sheyyitbaer besiman ry"a — eno niptar bebirkat harishon, apillu im hu gam ken lepanayv bishat habberaka ella shebberak bistam velo nitkavven liptor hashsheni bibraka zo. Veap al pi shemmin hassetam dato alayv, mikkol maqom eno bedin sheyyiptor sheeno chashub et hechashub bederek gerara, ella im ken nitkavven lepotro beperush, abal lo bistam (kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"v). Ukeshennitkavven lepotro — potero apillu lo haya lepanayv bishat beraka. Veim hebiuhu lepanayv beodo mebarek, ap al pi shehu yapeh min harishon vechabib alayv vegam hu min z' — yokal techilla min harishon (kevan shehitchil alayv habberaka shebberak alayv):

Natal beyado peri leoklo uberak alayv venapal miyyado veneebad o nimas ad sheeno rauy laakila veyesh mimmin zeh lepanayv od — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alehem, apillu hayeta dato alehem keshebberak, lepi shehabberaka chala al zeh sheachaz beyado keshebberak, vezeh poter et kullam, abal keshello akal et zeh — lo niptar babberaka shebberak al zeh. Umikkol maqom, haomed al ammat hammayim — mebarek veshoteh ap al pi shehammayim shehayu lepanayv keshebberak chalepu vehaleku, lepi shellekak nitkavven mittechilla shello lishtot mayim ellu ella mah sheyyabou achar birkato, vaalehem chala birkato. Veyesh omerim, shehabberaka chala al kol mah shemmukan lepanayv vedato alayv, veen tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv im napal miyyado happeri shebberak alayv. Veken im berak al hakkos venishpak vechozer umemalleo min haqqanqan sheomed lepanayv al hashshulchan o al hassapsal sheetzlo mukan lishtiyya — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv. Veken iqqar, lehaqel bispeq berakot. Vehu shehayeta dato beberur leekol velishtot mimmah shellepanayv, ap im lo haya nopel miyyado mah shebberak alayv, abal bistam en habberaka chala ella al mah shebbeyado bishat habberaka. Vaapillu im hayeta dato beberur leekol velishtot od — en habberaka chala al zeh ella keshehu lepanayv bishat habberaka, abal im achar kak hebiuhu lepanayv — tzarik lachazor ulebarek alayv im napal mah shebbeyado mimmennu, apillu bemaqom shello haya tzarik lebarek alayv im haya okel o shoteh mimmah shebbeyado keshebberak. (Ubammayim shebbeammat hammayim, kevan shehem meorabim umechubbarim vegup echad hem — habberaka al kullam, ap al mah shello haya lepanayv bishat habberaka):

Vekol zeh kesheokel o shoteh lebaddo, abal im yesh acherim immo vehu mebarek gam lahem lehotziam yede chobatan venapal mah shebbeyado achar habberaka — yesh omerim sheen tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ki habberaka chala gam al mah shebbeyad acherim, apillu lo achazu beyadam ella haya lipnehem — habberaka chala al mah shellipnehem keshehem toamim achar birkato, velaken gam hu en tzarik lachazor ulebarek al mah shemmebiim lo achar kak, raq shello yapsiq benetayim besicha:

Vekol maqom shehu tzarik lachazor ulebarek ubirkato harishona hi lebattala — tzarik lomar achareha: "baruk shem kebod malkuto leolam vaed". Veken kol mi shemmazkir shem shamayim lebattala. Veim napal miyyado haokel o nishpak hakkos qodem sheamar "elohenu" — yesayyem veyomar: "lammedeni chuqqeka", sheyyehe nireh keqore pasuq, veen kan hazkarat shem shamayim lebattala. Veken kol beraka lebattala shennizkar qodem sheyyomar "elohenu":

Berak al hammayim veshama sheyyesh met bashshekuna, uminhag lishpok kol mayim sheubin shebbishkunat hammet — yishteh meat min hammayim shello tehe birkato lebattala veachar kak yishpok hashshear. Veap lehaomerim shettaam hamminhag hu mippene shemmalak hammavet mattil tippat dam hammavet bammayim vehashshoteh mehen mistakken, mikkol maqom "shomer mitzva lo yeda dabar ra", umeachar sheshshata meat sheen birkato lebattala — yishpok hashshear mishshum chashash sakkana. Veim shama shehattequpa nopelet — yamtin meat ad sheobra hattequpa veyishteh, ki yesh omerim sheen sakkana bahem ella lishtot bishat hattequpa. Veap haomerim shekkol shello haya bahem barzel bishat hattequpa yesh sakkana lishtot mehem gam achar kak, mikkol maqom "shomer mitzva lo yeda dabar ra":
Hashshoteh mayim veshopek meat qodem shetiyyato mishshum chashash mayim haraim — yishpok qodem sheyyatchil lebarek velo achar habberaka, mishshum bizyon habberaka:
